product_metadata.title: Basic Beyond King Size Comforter Set Reversible Down Alternative Aqua Blue Comforter Set King 3 Pieces Bed Comforter with 2 Pillow Shams for All Season (Aqua Blue/Ivory)
features: IN THE BOX - King size down alternative reversible comforter (104"x92") + 2 pillow shams (20"x36") with 2 inches flange and invisible zipper.
LIGHTWEIGHT BUT WARM - Made of brushed microfiber fabric which makes the comforter more soft and comfortable. Plush polyester fill comforter that provides amazing all season warmth.
PRETTY AND COLORFUL - Refresh your bedroom with this bed comforter set from basic beyond.Its reversible design features two solid colors so you can achieve two different looks.
CARE INSTRUCTION - Machine wash in cold water on gentle cycle, and simply sun-dry or tumble dry on a low heat setting.

GREAT GIFT - Give your bedroom a style update with this beautiful comforter set that also has a matching pillowcase for a relaxing daytime nap or a cosy night's sleep.This comforter set can be an enchanting and valuable gift to your family or friends.
